items.titleOrig: OpenAI tools post user images from ChatGPT online
items.desc: OpenAI said it found 53 cases in which user-uploaded image links on ChatGPT were shared with third-party websites. The company said it had removed most of these links.

items.title: White House bars CNN from covering upcoming Trump trip, broadcaster says
items.titleOrig: White House bars CNN from covering upcoming Trump trip, broadcaster says
items.desc: CNN said its journalists have been barred from accompanying President Donald Trump on his upcoming trip to Tennessee. The episode marks the Trump administration's latest salvo against the major cable news network.

items.title: TikTok agrees to settle with Alabama state over teen safety
items.titleOrig: TikTok agrees to settle with Alabama state over teen safety
items.desc: The settlement involves TikTok adding several child safety measures to its platform including time limits and increased parental control. It is similar to a recent settlement competitor Meta had reached.

items.title: Yemeni leader calls for general mobilization against Houthis
items.titleOrig: Yemeni leader calls for general mobilization against Houthis
items.desc: Amid military escalation with the Iran-backed Houthis, the Saudi-backed head of Yemen's governing body urged his compatriots to join the government forces.

items.title: Lula or Bolsonaro as president? Brazil gears up to vote
items.titleOrig: Lula or Bolsonaro as president? Brazil gears up to vote
items.desc: Brazilians go to the polls on October 4. The front-runners are multilateralist incumbent Lula da Silva and former President Jair Bolsonaro's son, Flavio, who wants to bring Brazil closer to the US and away from China.

items.title: Germany news: Parliament approves fuel tax cut
items.titleOrig: Germany news: Parliament approves fuel tax cut
items.desc: German lawmakers hope to drive down fuel prices by cutting taxes on gas and diesel from October 1. Meanwhile, Germany's defense minister visited Budapest to ramp up defense and military ties.

items.title: Iranian President Pezeshkian brought a diplomatic tone to New York for UNGA. What did his remarks signal?
items.titleOrig: Iranian President Pezeshkian brought a diplomatic tone to New York for UNGA. What did his remarks signal?
items.desc: Iran's president used his trip to New York this week for the UN General Assembly to signal openness to talks over the nuclear dispute. However, the chances of a major breakthrough on the war remain low.

items.title: DW shows solidarity with Georgians' commitment to democracy
items.titleOrig: DW shows solidarity with Georgians' commitment to democracy
items.desc: Cultural and media professionals in Georgia remain under threat. A DW panel brings together insiders who share their hopes and fears.

items.title: Xi wraps up US visit with trip to National Archives
items.titleOrig: Xi wraps up US visit with trip to National Archives
items.desc: On the last day of his visit to the US, Chinese leader Xi Jinping visited the National Archives with President Donald Trump. The Archives store the Declaration of Independence and the US Constitution.
